correctness.rationale: For p prime, q=ell^r with ell != p, the p-term zero-frequency row sum of qth roots cannot vanish by the prime-power cyclotomic coefficient obstruction: a sum of p nonnegative integer multiplicities cannot have size divisible by ell. For k != 0, Q(zeta_q) and Q(zeta_p) are linearly disjoint; the only length-p kernel of evaluation at zeta_p^k is the scalar all-ones vector, so vanishing implies that translated pointwise product row is constant. Two constant rows of distinct translations force both f and g constant up to global phase. Thus either every row is constant (support p), exactly one row is constant (p²-p+1), or none (p²). The p choices of the unique constant row yield p(q^{p-1}-1) phase-normalized pairs; all remaining q^{2p-2} pairs fill support p². Critical algebra is all-parameter; five bounded direct-DFT enumerations (p,q)=(2,3),(3,2),(3,4),(5,2),(5,4) only corroborate it.
